questions.stem: A 58-year-old male with history of chronic alcohol consumption on routine check-up was found to have hepatomegaly. His LFT was essentially normal, Serum AFP was 490 ng//ml. CECT showed rapidly enhancing mass in the setting of nodularity. What is the likely diagnosis?
